answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The forge edge is recorded both ways, so a closed ring of 8 clones produces a signature the harbor analysis flags immediately. Anyone must thus build an open graph reaching real agents, and thus doing work rather than printing keys, and the vault settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 39 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
